name: fixpoint
description: USD-priced escrow on Hedera: invoices in dollars, payment in HBAR at a live Pyth rate, HTS NFT receipts, HCS audit trail.

steps.text: For Hedera testnet deploy and verify, see docs/testnet-evidence.md and packages/hardhat/README.md.

envVars.description: SQLite file for the local demo ledger (no database in the deployed template)
Optional Pyth Hermes API key, sent as x-api-key. Without it the app shows a labelled offline seed price
Testnet operator account for deploy and relayer scripts (ECDSA account, never commit)
Testnet operator private key for deploy and relayer scripts (never commit)
Pyth receiver contract address (defaults to the Hedera testnet receiver)
Pyth HBAR/USD feed id (resolve via Hermes price_feeds?query=HBAR)
Override for the HCS audit topic id
Override for the HTS receipt token id
Override for the mirror node REST base URL
